description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi Cave Guard's power.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 targeting any artifact you control.
